ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: In the food web diagram, what will happen to the squirrel population if all the grass dies?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the food web diagram, the grass labeled “GRASS” is located at the lower left, and the squirrel labeled “SQUIRREL” is located above it. There is an arrow in the diagram from GRASS to SQUIRREL, indicating that grass is one of the food sources of the squirrel. Reasoning: The condition of the question is that all the grass has died. According to food web rules, if a consumer’s food source disappears, the food it can obtain will decrease, so the population size of that consumer will usually decrease. Therefore, the squirrel population will decrease.
